tool_args.rationale: The low-gradient rows identify the archived sink-gradient saturation plus square-root branch. After subtracting that fitted base, the three high-gradient losses divided by u_now are 0.29, 0.7975, and 1.45, exactly proportional to the gradient above 1.35. Fit all parameters numerically and seek fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Thresholded power-law loss independent of u_now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The previous candidate was refuted on fresh confirmation; the observed high-gradient losses instead scale exactly with u_now times the excess gradient.
It fits the low-gradient observations but substantially overpredicts the three high-gradient observations.
Both have already been acquired; the combined observations identify the proposed five-parameter law without another measurement.
